method: Twenty native circles retain numbered diameter and line-weight proportions. Twenty-four brace impressions resolve to thirteen forms and eleven rotated repeats; the opposed No.11 specimens have different lengths and curvature proportions. Full native comparisons and rotated retrieval find no exact prior forms. Existing small outlined-circle symbols have much heavier relative strokes. Tables and instructional margin diagrams remain documentary compositions.
